# Select in the bootstrap look

Its parts, props and data attributes: [Select](https://menhir-ui.com/docs/components/select.md).

## SelectExample.tsx

```tsx
import { Select } from "menhir/select";

import styles from "./select.module.css";

function Indicator() {
  return (
    <Select.ItemIndicator class={styles.indicator}>
      <svg
        aria-hidden="true"
        viewBox="0 0 16 16"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        stroke-width="2"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        stroke-linejoin="round"
      >
        <path d="M3 8.5 6.5 12 13 4.5" />
      </svg>
    </Select.ItemIndicator>
  );
}

export default function SelectExample() {
  return (
    <div class={styles.field}>
      <label for="select-fruit-bootstrap">Fruit</label>
      <Select.Root name="fruit" defaultValue="apple">
        <Select.Trigger id="select-fruit-bootstrap" class={styles.trigger}>
          <Select.Value class={styles.value} placeholder="Pick a fruit" />
          <svg
            aria-hidden="true"
            viewBox="0 0 16 16"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            stroke-width="2"
            stroke-linecap="round"
            stroke-linejoin="round"
            class={styles.chevron}
          >
            <path d="m3 6 5 5 5-5" />
          </svg>
        </Select.Trigger>
        <Select.Popup sideOffset={2} class={styles.popup}>
          <Select.Item class={styles.item} value="apple">
            Apple
            <Indicator />
          </Select.Item>
          <Select.Item class={styles.item} value="banana">
            Banana
            <Indicator />
          </Select.Item>
          <Select.Item class={styles.item} value="cherry" disabled>
            Cherry
            <Indicator />
          </Select.Item>
          {/* A listbox holds only options and groups, so the separator is
              hidden from assistive technology. */}
          <div aria-hidden="true" class={styles.separator} />
          <Select.Group>
            <Select.GroupLabel class={styles.groupLabel}>
              Citrus
            </Select.GroupLabel>
            <Select.Item class={styles.item} value="lemon">
              Lemon
              <Indicator />
            </Select.Item>
            <Select.Item class={styles.item} value="orange">
              Orange
              <Indicator />
            </Select.Item>
          </Select.Group>
        </Select.Popup>
      </Select.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## select.module.css

```css
/* Bootstrap's .form-select, as a button that opens Bootstrap's dropdown: the
   list in a card below it, as wide as the Trigger at least (--anchor-width)
   and no taller than the space left (--available-height). Menhir places the
   Popup; the item the keys or the pointer reached has data-active, which
   takes Bootstrap's hover and focus, a disabled one data-disabled, which
   the keys and the pointer still reach, and the selected one data-selected,
   shown by its indicator. */
.field {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--spacer-2);
  width: 15rem;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.trigger {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--spacer-2);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem;
  border: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color);
  border-radius: var(--bs-border-radius);
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
  font: inherit;
  text-align: start;
  transition:
    border-color 0.15s ease-in-out,
    box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out;
}

.trigger:focus-visible {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bs-white) 50%, var(--bs-primary));
  outline: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--bs-focus-ring-width) var(--bs-focus-ring-color);
}

.trigger[data-disabled] {
  background-color: var(--bs-secondary-bg);
}

.value {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.value[data-placeholder] {
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
}

.chevron {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
}

/* The Popup is hidden while closed, so it takes no display of its own. */
.popup {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  min-width: var(--anchor-width);
  max-height: var(--available-height);
  padding: var(--spacer-2) 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  border: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
  border-radius: var(--bs-border-radius);
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  background-clip: padding-box;
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
  font-size: 1rem;
  text-align: start;
  box-shadow: var(--bs-box-shadow);
  transition: opacity 0.15s linear;
}

/* Exit: Menhir keeps the Popup shown until this transition ends. */
.popup[data-closed] {
  opacity: 0;
}

/* Entry: where the Popup starts from when it opens. */
@starting-style {
  .popup[data-open] {
    opacity: 0;
  }
}

.item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--spacer-2);
  padding: var(--spacer-1) var(--spacer-3);
  color: var(--bs-body-color);
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: default;
  user-select: none;
}

.item[data-active] {
  background-color: var(--bs-tertiary-bg);
}

.item:active:not([data-disabled]) {
  background-color: var(--bs-primary);
  color: var(--bs-white);
}

.item[data-disabled] {
  color: var(--bs-tertiary-color);
}

/* After the item's text, at its end. */
.indicator {
  display: flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 1em;
  height: 1em;
  margin-inline-start: auto;
}

.indicator[data-unselected] {
  visibility: hidden;
}

.indicator svg {
  width: 1em;
  height: 1em;
}

.groupLabel {
  padding: var(--spacer-2) var(--spacer-3);
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.separator {
  margin: var(--spacer-2) 0;
  border-top: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color-translucent);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .trigger,
  .popup {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```
